The parser encountered issues with struct literal syntax. I adjusted the parsing logic to properly handle struct initialization patterns and brace matching for object literals.

The server started but didn't respond to requests. Running it in the foreground was blocking output, so I launched it in the background with output redirection to allow proper request handling.
